_meta.description: Canonical navigation layout applied AFTER all manifest.d fragments merge (see buildManifest/applyMenuLayout in @conduction/nextcloud-vue). Fragments stay the source of WHAT exists in the menu (ADR-037); this file is the single place deciding WHERE entries live. relocations: sourceId -> targetGroupId (groups dissolve into the target, leaves move under it, a child group targeting its own parent flattens). removals: leaf menu-entry ids retired as duplicate navigation — their PAGES stay routable for deep links. settingsSection: menu-entry ids promoted into Nextcloud's settings foldout (the bottom-left gear). Lives outside manifest.json because the app-manifest-v2 schema has additionalProperties:false at the root.

_settingsSectionNote: Empty on purpose. ADR-079 Decision 5 names hrmq's top-level Configuratie entry (Administraties, Integraties) as a candidate for the settings foldout, but relocating it is a menu-structure decision the fragment-pipeline change deliberately does not make (hrmq-manifest-fragment-pipeline is a byte-identical refactor; see its proposal.md non-goals). The later ADR-097-scoped navigation change decides what moves here.
_navigationRationaleNote: Menu-structure decisions and their reasoning belong in this block (the pipelinq/openconnector convention) — manifest menu entries cannot carry their own rationale because the menuItem schema is additionalProperties:false. Empty because the pipeline-adoption change made no navigation decisions; the first entry lands with the first real relocation/removal.
